support_methods_subtitle: Kālet wewein lelok eo kwoj kōnaan. Kajjojo jabawōt ej jiban ñan download ko, hosting ko, im test hardware ko.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis ej kōmman firmware ko rekãl ñan ri ikkure ro einwõt Y1 (ej target hidden board revisions einwõt 6.0, 7.0, im 8.0) ko rej jolok device ko remor. Men eo enana tata, website eo air ejjab letok kakkōl ko im ejelok maroñ ñan firmware ko rar jerbal mokta ñan bar jeblak jen juon jekjek eo ekar jorrāān. Updater im Community Firmware project rej bōk men ko: jej archive aolep stock ROM ko, make lale hardware revision eo am, im kejbãrok player eo am bwe en jerbal ilo jimwe.
support_story_1_headline: Ñe ri kōmman men ko rej etal wōt, armij ro rej wōnmanlok.
support_story_1_item_1: Lomoren Ri ikkure ro Rejorrāān: Lale ko rej kōmman bwe update ko rekãl ren jab kakkure hardware ko remootlok.
support_story_1_item_2: Archived Stock ROMs: Complete collection of original factory firmwares Innioasis deleted.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Kein jerbal ko rejejjet ñan macOS, Linux, im Windows.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Automatic board detection bwe en maroñ in bōk package eo ejimwe.
support_story_1_lead: Kōjparok device eo am jen hardware ko rejjab konono im revision ko renana.
support_story_2_body: Lale Innioasis software eo ej melelen etale forum ko ñan Google Drive link ko emoj aer jerbal, Baidu cloud share ko remej, im zip file ko rebin im ejelok kein jerbal ko rej flash. Kōm kar kalōk juon network in download eo etiljek, make iaer ippāñ SHA-256 eo emol, kōjjelā ko kin kōkāāl ko, im step-by-step guided install ko. Jabawōt ko am rej kejbãrok download ko im hosting ko rej kōmmane men in 24 awa ilo juon raan, 365 raan ilo juon yio.
support_story_2_headline: Ejelok Google Drives ko rerup. Ejelok lemnok. Firmware eo ej jerbal wōt.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Mōkaj, direct downloads im ejelok joñan download ko ak dead link ko.
support_story_2_item_2: Kōjjelā ko rekāāl: Bōk kōjjelā ilo ien eo rej walok ak kōkmman ko rekāāl rej walok.
support_story_2_item_3: Guided Step-by-Step Installs: Clear visual prompts rej tel yuk ilo am jibwe button ko.
support_story_2_item_4: Multilingual Community: Ej lukkun ilo kajin English, Chinese, German, Spanish, French & Japanese.
support_story_2_lead: Elap an mõkaj, kein jerbal ko an jukjuk in bed eo emōj an mol im kwomaroñ atartar ion.
support_story_3_body: Stock factory software ej baj kalikar wōt ta eo Y1 ak Y2 hardware eo am emaron kōmmane. Jikin kwelok eo am ear bōktok Rockbox, operating system ko redik, audiophile codec playback, im custom theme ko ñan mour. Jej wiaik kein jerbal ko reoktak jen dron ñan test, reverse engineer, im verify aolep install ko. Updater ej jiban ñan test unit kein im kōmman bwe en mõkaj an kōmman firmware.
support_story_3_headline: Kōmman bwe en maroñ in jerbal aolep Innioasis player eo am.
support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Audiophile playback im custom theme ko rej install ilo jejjo wōt second ko.
support_story_3_item_2: Community Firmware: Kōkōmanmanlok battery ko, UI eo erreolok, im jiban in audio codec ko rekāāl.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Jej test ion kein jerbal ko remol mokta jen ad kōmman jabdrewot build.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% ejelok wōnāān, software eo ej lale men ko an armij im ejelok ads ak tracking.
support_story_3_lead: Bōktok Rockbox, operating system ko remera, im anemkwoj in audiophile.
support_story_4_body: Ñe juon kombani in hardware ej etal ñan gadget eo air tok juon, model ko remootlok rej jolok. Innioasis ejjab letok jiban in Linux, ejelok changelog ko realikar, im ejelok wāween eo epidodo ñan bar jeblak ñe juon install ej likjab. Updater ej bed kinke ro rej kajerbale rejjab aikuj in jolok juon kein al eo emman. 100% in jipan ko an jukjuk in pād eo rej etal wōt ñan kōjparok kein jerbal in ñan aolep.
support_story_4_headline: Jipan kim kōmmane ta eo Innioasis ejjab kōmmane.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Proven recovery flows meñe device ko rejjab kōnan boot.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux First-Class Support: MediaTek ej jerbal ilo Linux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Detailed release notes bwe kwon jelā ta oktak ko.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Community Funded: Kajjojo kobe ej kōmman bwe en bellok im ejelok wōnāān ñan aolep.
support_story_4_lead: Kōjparok firmware eo ej jerbal jen jukjuk in pād eo ej kōjparok kein jerbal ko am jen jikin jolok bōtōktōk ko.

1. Kōjerbal player eo am ilo am jibwe Power button eo.
2. Ñe Rockbox ej boot, likit USB cable eo ilo computer eo am.
3. Elañe ej walok ilo screen in player eo, kamool USB Storage mode bwe device eo en walok einwot juon drive.
